def transform(grid):
    # Expand to a 3-by-2 reflected tiling: vertical [flip, original, flip],
    # horizontal [left-right mirror, original].
    base = [row[:] for row in grid]
    vertical = list(reversed(base)) + base + list(reversed(base))
    return [list(reversed(row)) + row for row in vertical]
PY
